rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: ByteRay is an AI-powered reverse code engineering platform for binary vulnerability analysis. It exposes 38 MCP tools for taint tracing, zero-day discovery, and binary analysis workflows. Users open a binary via the MCP interface, receive a session ID, then use the session to run analysis tools against compiled code. Available as a hosted streamable HTTP endpoint.
